finalText:
One thing worth a sanity check before you ship it: **`#4223` (auth returning 401 instead of 403 for expired tokens) is a genuine breaking change**, not a bugfix — I put it under Breaking rather than Fixed since anyone branching on status code will need to update. Worth confirming with whoever owns auth that this was intentional and not itself a bug.

Everything else that touched `src/` and wasn't a dep bump, refactor, test, or internal rename turned out to be noise — same handful of fix/refactor patterns (rename `Ctx`→`RequestCtx`, "drop unused v2 debug helper", "move config loader", etc.) repeated across nearly every module, none of which change observable behavior. The 11 PRs above (10 fixes + 1 feature) are the only ones that do.
